title: omni test spec (format version 1)
description: The shape of an omni spec file under the version-1 strict rules: entries carry only the nine defined fields, at most one of in/args/ctx, and never err together with out. Legacy (version-0) specs are not required to satisfy this schema. The runner is the authority; this schema exists for editor completion and CI validation of spec artifacts.

node.description: Any spec value. Objects are containers (sections, groups, DEF blocks); everything else is data. Descent stops at entries, whose own maps (in, out, match, ...) are data, not containers.

DEF.description: Section metadata (client declarations and their options). Opaque to the structural schema: option payloads are unrestricted JSON, so descent stops here as it does at entries.

ctx.description: Single context argument, passed through provider.contextify.

out.description: Expected result, compared with deep equality.

err.description: true accepts any error; /pattern/ matches as a regex; any other string as a case-insensitive substring.

match.description: Partial structure check against {in, args, out, ctx, err}.

client.description: Resolve the subject from this DEF.client entry.

id.description: Identifier echoed in failure messages; convention: 'group#label'.

doc.description: Marks the entry as the canonical documentation example (requires an id).
